title: Build the game in the right order
instruction: Put the parts of Catch the Apples in order, so that each one comes after what it depends on.
steps: The basket moves with the arrow keys
The apple falls from top to bottom
The game recognises that the apple landed in the basket
A catch adds a point, a miss takes away a life
At zero lives the game ends and shows the score
why: Without a moving basket you can’t test anything: the player couldn’t catch a thing.
You need the falling apple so that there is something to catch.
A catch can only be recognised once the basket moves and the apple falls.
Points and lives change when you catch or miss, so they need the catch check.
Game over watches the lives, and they have to go down first.
debrief: You build a big game out of small parts. Each one stands on the ones before it, and that’s why the order matters.
